title: Android Back from a selector popup also closes the drawer
severity_basis: Unexpected extra navigation requires reopening the drawer. No saved-list changes or loss were observed.
environment: Qt 6.12, isolated QShopper_API_36 Android 16 emulator-5580, gesture navigation, existing x86_64 debug APK.
expected: User clarified on 2026-10-31: Close only the selector popup first. Leave the drawer open; another Back closes the drawer while preserving edit mode.
reproduction: Launch with unique QSHOPPER_DATA_DIR and an isolated milk/bread fixture.
Enter edit mode, open the drawer, and open Lists, Accent or Primary.
Perform a completed Android left-edge Back gesture while the selector popup is open.
Observe that both popup and drawer close; editing and saved items remain.
observed: Strict final run reproduces the extra drawer dismissal for all three selectors. An earlier observational run left Accent open, so the behavior may depend on timing or geometry; root cause is not established.

regression.before: 3 selector failures; 7 other Back/data controls pass. Script exits nonzero and retains screenshots, accessibility trees and results.json.
regression.after: Not run: no application fix implemented. After fixing, verify popup-only dismissal and the next Back closing only the drawer; preserve editor/draft, foreground and saved-list invariants.
regression.platform_scope: Real Android edge gestures; desktop Escape checks do not certify this behavior. Extend both-edge/native state coverage when fixing.

implementation_scope: Recorded during QA-003 coverage work. App fix deferred to a separately selected ticket.
